# System API

5 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/system/info`

Detailed system information

Administrator-only runtime and build details

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | System information | `application/json`: [SystemInfo](schemas.md#systeminfo) |
| `403` | Administrator access required | - |

### `GET /api/v1/system/info`

System information

Returns the public version and health status. Detailed build and runtime information is available to administrators at /api/v1/admin/system/info

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | System information | `application/json`: [PublicSystemInfo](schemas.md#publicsysteminfo) |

### `GET /health`

Health check

Returns the health status of the server and its components

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Health status | `application/json`: [HealthResponse](schemas.md#healthresponse) |

### `GET /metrics`

Prometheus metrics

Returns Prometheus-format metrics

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Metrics in Prometheus format | `text/plain`: string |
| `401` | Unauthorized (if METRICS_AUTH_TOKEN is set) | - |

### `GET /ready`

Readiness check

Returns whether the server is ready to accept requests

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Server is ready | `application/json`: [ReadyResponse](schemas.md#readyresponse) |
| `503` | Server is not ready | `application/json`: [ReadyResponse](schemas.md#readyresponse) |
